limitations.statement: CPA is not a replacement for experimental validation.
Systematic hyperparameter tuning recommended for best performance.
Scalable Bayesian uncertainty models are promising alternatives for future work.
When predicting OOD combinations, access to single-drug data is crucial.
CPA will fail if test data are very different from training data; uncertainty estimation via distance-based heuristic.
Data uncertainty and biases can bias the model; genes co-measured with other genes show more complex predictions.
Extension to other modalities (e.g., multimodal CRISPR, ATAC-seq, spatial transcriptomics) is possible.
CPA currently based on gene expression alone; cannot capture post-transcriptional modification, signaling, or cell communication.
Current implementation uses deterministic autoencoder; variational extension possible.
